findings.description: The new trunk-rule bullet added by this delta lists pushd as a fallback trigger for reading the session's directory but omits popd, even though the code (IS_DIRSTACK='^[[:space:]]*(pushd|popd)([[:space:]]|$)') and the adjacent SCOPED comment in git-safety.sh (also revised in this commit, 'so does every command after a pushd or popd') treat them identically.

Folding the new DATA stream into COMMANDS (fixing the prior permissiveness regression) means an agent on trunk that writes a shell/CI script whose heredoc body lines begin with `git commit`/`git push` is now blocked, where the immediately-prior commit (6d9e58c) allowed it. This is intentional per ADR decision 27 and locked by a new test, but worth reviewer awareness as a behavioral tightening, not a defect.

The new DATA variable adds a third source feeding the already dense CODE/EXPANDED/FED/SPLIT/PAYLOADS/MAIN_COMMANDS/SUBSTITUTED/COMMANDS pipeline (a pre-existing density issue from the prior round), threaded into both COMMANDS and a second while-loop's heredoc input.

The trunk-refspec grep `[[:space:]]$TRUNK([[:space:]]|$)` requires whitespace-or-end right after the trunk name, so `(cd <trunk checkout> && git push origin main)` reaches it as `...main)` and the `)` fails the boundary, letting a subshell-wrapped push to trunk skip the refspec check (cd-tracking is separately disabled by SCOPED noticing the `(`, so the branch check also falls back to the session directory). Present identically in the merge-base file (6e26bd5), not introduced by this PR.

process_issues.description: RESTORE_PATHS for this repo's review workflow is "AGENTS.md .agents templates" (templates/ is included because .agents/ symlinks into it), but the .claude-pr/ snapshot this run only contained CLAUDE.md and .claude/ -- no templates/ copy was preserved there, even though the working tree's templates/ was in fact restored to the merge-base version (confirmed: templates/agents/hooks/policies/git-safety.sh and CONTRACT.md on disk were the pre-PR versions). The documented fallback ("Read .claude-pr/<path>" for the PR's real content) was therefore unavailable for the two files this PR actually changes; reviewers had to be redirected to `git show <head-sha>:<path>` instead, which worked but is a workaround the skill's instructions don't describe for this gap.
